quranTranslation.text: He said: I expose my distress and anguish only unto Allah, and I know from Allah that which ye know not.

explanation.bs: „Ja se na svoju muku i svoju tugu žalim samo Allahu“ – Jakubova tuga za Jusufom.
explanation.en: “I expose my distress and anguish [ḥuzn] only unto Allah” — Jacob's grief for Joseph.

quranTranslation.text: And they say: Praise be to Allah Who hath put grief away from us. Lo! Our Lord is Forgiving, Bountiful,

explanation.bs: „Hvala Allahu koji je od nas otklonio tugu“ – riječi stanovnika Dženneta.
explanation.en: “Praise be to Allah Who hath put grief away from us” — the words of the people of Paradise.

quranTranslation.text: Yet it may be, if they believe not in this statement, that thou (Muhammad) wilt torment thy soul with grief over their footsteps.

explanation.bs: Možda ćeš sebe od žalosti uništiti ako oni u ovaj govor ne povjeruju – Poslanikova žalost zbog onih koji odbijaju.
explanation.en: You might kill yourself with grief if they do not believe in this message — the Prophet's sorrow over those who refuse.

quranTranslation.text: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,

explanation.bs: „Pa smo te spasili od tjeskobe“ – Musa nakon što je ubio čovjeka.
explanation.en: “We delivered thee from great distress” — Moses after he had killed a man.

quranTranslation.text: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.

explanation.bs: Junusa smo spasili od tjeskobe.
explanation.en: We saved Jonah from the distress.

quranTranslation.text: When ye climbed (the hill) and paid no heed to anyone, while the messenger, in your rear, was calling you (to fight). Therefor He rewarded you grief for (his) grief, that (He might teach) you not to sorrow either for that which ye missed or for that which befell you. Allah is Informed of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „Pa vam je uzvratio tjeskobom na tjeskobu“ – Uhud; tefsir se razilazi o tome koje su to dvije tjeskobe.
explanation.en: “Therefor He rewarded you grief for grief” — Uḥud; tafsir differs on what the two distresses were.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk, who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaying your sons and sparing your women: that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.

explanation.bs: Faraonovi ljudi su vas najgorim mukama mučili – عَذَاب koji nanose ljudi.
explanation.en: Pharaoh's people afflicted you with the worst torment — عَذَاب inflicted by people.

quranTranslation.text: And when your Lord proclaimed: If ye give thanks, I will give you more; but if ye are thankless, lo! My punishment is dire.

explanation.bs: „A ako budete nezahvalni, Moja je kazna doista žestoka.“
explanation.en: “But if ye are thankless, lo! My punishment is dire.”

quranTranslation.text: Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be an awful doom.

explanation.bs: Njih čeka velika patnja.
explanation.en: And for them is a great punishment.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Profane not Allah's monuments nor the Sacred Month nor the offerings nor the garlands, nor those repairing to the Sacred House, seeking the grace and pleasure of their Lord. But when ye have left the sacred territory, then go hunting (if ye will). And let not your hatred of a folk who (once) stopped your going to the inviolable place of worship seduce you to transgress; but help ye one another unto righteousness and pious duty. Help not one another unto sin and transgression, but keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is severe in punishment.

explanation.bs: „Allah je, doista, žestok u kažnjavanju“ – na kraju ajeta o zabranama.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah is severe in punishment [ʿiqāb]” — closing an ayah of prohibitions.

quranTranslation.text: The folk of Noah and the factions after them denied (their messengers) before these, and every nation purposed to seize their messenger and argued falsely, (thinking) thereby to refute the Truth. Then I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment.

explanation.bs: „Pa sam ih Ja ščepao – i kakva je bila Moja kazna!“
explanation.en: “Then I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment.”

quranTranslation.text: And they bid thee hasten on the evil rather than the good, when exemplary punishments have indeed occurred before them. But lo! thy Lord is rich in pardon for mankind despite their wrong, and lo! thy Lord is strong in punishment.

explanation.bs: Gospodar tvoj oprašta ljudima, a i žestoko kažnjava – oprost i kazna jedno uz drugo.
explanation.en: Your Lord is full of forgiveness for the people, and severe in penalty — forgiveness and penalty side by side.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when Luqman said unto his son, when he was exhorting him: O my dear son! Ascribe no partners unto Allah. Lo! to ascribe partners (unto Him) is a tremendous wrong -

explanation.bs: „Zaista, širk je golema nepravda“ – ẓulm prema Allahu; Poslanik je tim ajetom objasnio ẓulm u 6:82.
explanation.en: “To ascribe partners (unto Him) is a tremendous wrong” — ẓulm against Allah; with this ayah the Prophet explained the ẓulm of 6:82.

quranTranslation.text: Whoso doeth that through aggression and injustice, we shall cast him into Fire, and that is ever easy for Allah.

explanation.bs: Ko to učini „iz neprijateljstva i nepravde“ – عُدْوَان i ظُلْم jedno uz drugo.
explanation.en: Whoever does that “through aggression and injustice” — عُدْوَان and ظُلْم side by side.

quranTranslation.text: A plight like that of Noah's folk, and A'ad and Thamud, and those after them, and Allah willeth no injustice for (His) slaves.

explanation.bs: Allah ne želi nepravdu robovima – ẓulm koji Allah od Sebe odbija.
explanation.en: Allah wants no injustice for His servants — ẓulm, which Allah disowns for His servants.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.

explanation.bs: Allah zabranjuje razvrat, odvratnost i nasilje (بَغْي) – nepravda prema drugima.
explanation.en: Allah forbids immorality, bad conduct and oppression (بَغْي) — wrong done to others.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! religion with Allah (is) the Surrender (to His Will and Guidance). Those who (formerly) received the Scripture differed only after knowledge came unto them, through transgression among themselves. Whoso disbelieveth the revelations of Allah (will find that) lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.

explanation.bs: Razišli su se tek kad im je došlo znanje, „iz međusobnog nasilja“ (بَغْيًا) – suparništvo, ne neznanje.
explanation.en: They differed only after knowledge came to them, “through transgression among themselves” (بَغْيًا) — rivalry, not ignorance.

quranTranslation.text: Yet when He hath delivered them, behold! they rebel in the earth wrongfully. O mankind! Your rebellion is only against yourselves. (Ye have) enjoyment of the life of the world; then unto Us is your return and We shall proclaim unto you what ye used to do.

explanation.bs: „O ljudi, vaše nasilje je samo protiv vas samih“ – بَغْي se vraća onome ko ga čini.
explanation.en: “O mankind! Your rebellion is only against yourselves” — بَغْي recoils on its doer.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Profane not Allah's monuments nor the Sacred Month nor the offerings nor the garlands, nor those repairing to the Sacred House, seeking the grace and pleasure of their Lord. But when ye have left the sacred territory, then go hunting (if ye will). And let not your hatred of a folk who (once) stopped your going to the inviolable place of worship seduce you to transgress; but help ye one another unto righteousness and pious duty. Help not one another unto sin and transgression, but keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is severe in punishment.

explanation.bs: „A u grijehu i neprijateljstvu ne sarađujte jedni s drugima“ – عُدْوَان uz إِثْم.
explanation.en: “Help not one another unto sin and transgression” — عُدْوَان beside إِثْم.

quranTranslation.text: And fight them until persecution is no more, and religion is for Allah. But if they desist, then let there be no hostility except against wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „Neka nema neprijateljstva osim prema nepravednicima“ – mnogi mufessiri tumače da se pravedan odgovor zove عُدْوَان po paralelizmu s nasiljem na koje odgovara.
explanation.en: “Let there be no hostility except against wrong-doers” — many mufassirun explain the just response as called عُدْوَان by parallel with the aggression it answers.

quranTranslation.text: He said: That (is settled) between thee and me. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil, there will be no injustice to me, and Allah is Surety over what we say.

explanation.bs: Musa: „pa neka nema prekoračenja prema meni“ – prelaženje dogovorene granice.
explanation.en: Moses: “there will be no injustice to me” — overstepping an agreed limit.

quranTranslation.text: Muhammad is but a messenger, messengers (the like of whom) have passed away before him. Will it be that, when he dieth or is slain, ye will turn back on your heels? He who turneth back on his heels doth no hurt to Allah, and Allah will reward the thankful.

explanation.bs: „Zar ako umre ili bude ubijen…“ – smrt Poslanika iskazana sa مَاتَ.
explanation.en: “When he dieth or is slain…” — the Prophet's death expressed with مَاتَ.

quranTranslation.text: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!

explanation.bs: Merjem: „Da sam barem umrla prije ovoga!“ – čovjek o svojoj smrti.
explanation.en: Mary: “Oh, would that I had died ere this” — a person speaking of her own death.

quranTranslation.text: Allah receiveth (men's) souls at the time of their death, and that (soul) which dieth not (yet) in its sleep. He keepeth that (soul) for which He hath ordained death and dismisseth the rest till an appointed term. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought.

explanation.bs: Allah uzima duše kad umru (مَوْت), i one koje ne umru (لَمْ تَمُتْ) – u snu: oba glagola u jednom ajetu.
explanation.en: Allah takes the souls at death, and those that do not die (لَمْ تَمُتْ) during sleep — both verbs in one ayah.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who gathereth you at night and knoweth that which ye commit by day. Then He raiseth you again to life therein, that the term appointed (for you) may be accomplished. And afterward unto Him is your return. Then He will proclaim unto you what ye used to do.

explanation.bs: On vam noću uzima duše (يَتَوَفَّاكُم), u snu – تَوَفَّى i za san.
explanation.en: He takes your souls by night (in sleep) — تَوَفَّى said of sleep too.

gloss.bs: uzeti dušu (u smrti i u snu)
gloss.en: to take the soul (in death and in sleep)

quranTranslation.text: Say: The angel of death, who hath charge concerning you, will gather you, and afterward unto your Lord ye will be returned.

explanation.bs: „Uzet će vam duše melek smrti“ – melek kao subjekt.
explanation.en: “The angel of death … will gather you” — an angel as subject.

gloss.bs: uzeti dušu (u smrti i u snu)
gloss.en: to take the soul (in death and in sleep)

quranTranslation.text: Our Lord! Lo! we have heard a crier calling unto Faith: "Believe ye in your Lord!" So we believed. Our Lord! Therefor forgive us our sins, and remit from us our evil deeds, and make us die the death of the righteous.

explanation.bs: „I uzmi nam duše s dobrima“ – molba Allahu da On uzme dušu.
explanation.en: “And make us die the death of the righteous” — asking Allah to take the soul.

gloss.bs: uzeti dušu (u smrti i u snu)
gloss.en: to take the soul (in death and in sleep)

quranTranslation.text: And He made fast the hills,

explanation.bs: „A planine (جِبَال) je učvrstio (أَرْسَاهَا)“ – ime planine s glagolom istog korijena kao رَوَاسِي; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And He made fast (أَرْسَاهَا) the hills (جِبَال)” — the name of the mountain with a verb of the root of رَوَاسِي; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain, thou (O Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such similitudes coin We for mankind that haply they may reflect.

explanation.bs: „Da ovaj Kur'an spustimo na neku planinu (جَبَل), vidio bi je kako je ponizna i kako puca od straha pred Allahom“ – slika čvrstoga koje se predaje.
explanation.en: “If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain (جَبَل), thou verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah” — an image of the firm thing yielding.

quranTranslation.text: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,

explanation.bs: „I planine (جِبَال) će se silno kretati“ – Sudnji dan.
explanation.en: “And the mountains (جِبَال) move away with (awful) movement” — the Last Day.

quranTranslation.text: And He hath cast into the earth firm hills that it quake not with you, and streams and roads that ye may find a way.

explanation.bs: „I bacio je na Zemlju čvrsto usađena brda (رَوَاسِي) da se s vama ne ljulja.“
explanation.en: “And He hath cast into the earth firm hills (رَوَاسِي) that it quake not with you.”

quranTranslation.text: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?

explanation.bs: „I na njoj smo postavili visoka, čvrsto usađena brda (رَوَاسِي)“ – ar-Rāġib: čvrste planine.
explanation.en: “And placed therein high [firm] mountains (رَوَاسِي)” — ar-Rāġib: firm mountains.

quranTranslation.text: They made for him what he willed: synagogues and statues, basins like wells and boilers built into the ground. Give thanks, O House of David! Few of My bondmen are thankful.

explanation.bs: Džini su Sulejmanu pravili „i nepomične kotlove (رَاسِيَات)“ – isto svojstvo čvrstine, izvan planina; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: The jinn made for Solomon “boilers built into the ground (رَاسِيَات)” — the same quality of firmness, outside mountains; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
